cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Stay for the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Create increasing moments of emotional honesty to test whether someone remains present and supportive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll sort the anniversary trip tonight. Leave the laptop shut a minute; I haven't booked anything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought you just needed help with the flights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can look at flights after. I was relieved when the cheap seats sold out. Can you hear the rest?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave it shut. Is it the trip, or us?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Us. I hoped a cancellation would say it for me. Can we stay here together while I explain?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 confidently manages trip planning; A3 allows later flight work while testing whether B hears more; A5 depends on B staying after deeper relationship honesty.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 cheap seats sold out does not imply a booking existed; A5 hoped-for cancellation is a desired excuse, not a claimed actual event.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers practical help and B4 sets it aside to ask whether the relationship is the issue.

heightening.evidence: B4 relationship question enables A5 direct us admission and a stronger test of remaining together.

specificity.evidence: A1 anniversary trip and unbooked travel establish why B initially thinks flights; later lines reveal the emotional purpose.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 direct answer, admission of evasion and presence request each deepen what B must hear and agree to.

reservation: The promise to look at flights after is a fragile management tactic, not proof the trip will happen. The scene stays deliberately tender.
